color.note: A DevBrain theme over shadcn's neutral theme: same variable names, Tailwind v4 colours. Light is shadcn's light theme except the ring; dark keeps shadcn's values except where a usage note says DevBrain override. Status colours use the 700 step in light so they stay legible on white.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page, sidebar, list and card ground.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text (15.7:1 dark). DevBrain dark override: shadcn uses neutral-50; the Figma screens use neutral-200 to soften long lists.

tokens.name: foreground-strong
tokens.usage: Titles and the names in rows (18:1 dark). DevBrain addition.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card ground: Home summary cards and settings groups, outlined with `border` (overrides shadcn's neutral-900 card in dark).

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the command palette, tooltips, dialogs, sheets and toasts (Figma draws dialogs and toasts on a near-black #111; this is the nearest Tailwind step).

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover` (14.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The rare filled button, checked checkbox and switch on. DevBrain's everyday button is the quiet `secondary` one.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `primary`. shadcn default.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Default button fill, selected sidebar item, segmented-control thumb (Figma neutral-900; overrides shadcn's neutral-800).

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Group-heading band, all-day row, calendar event block, code (overrides shadcn's neutral-800).

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, placeholders, menu icons, descriptions. shadcn default (7.7:1 dark, 4.7:1 light).

tokens.name: subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Dates, issue keys, previews: metadata a reader can skip. DevBrain addition; 4.2:1 in dark, so never for instructions or errors.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and keyboard highlight on menu items and rows (Figma neutral-900; overrides shadcn's neutral-800).

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete actions: red text on a quiet button and in menus, never a red fill (6.2:1 on neutral-900 dark).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Row dividers, pills, cards, checkbox outline, sidebar edge: Figma's solid neutral-900 line (overrides shadcn's white at 10%).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of buttons, menus, dialogs, toasts and the selected sidebar item (Figma neutral-800). DevBrain addition.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Nova's ring-1 ring-foreground/10: the outline of cards, menus, popovers, dialogs, sheets and toasts.

tokens.name: row-selected
tokens.usage: Selected rows (option D): a light tint over the ground; neighbours join into one block.

tokens.name: row-selected-foreground
tokens.usage: Row titles while selected.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input and select borders (overrides shadcn's white at 15%).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline: the border turns `ring` with a 3px `ring` halo at 50% (shadcn's focus ring).

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar ground. DevBrain dark override: shadcn uses neutral-900; the Figma sidebar sits on the page colour.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Sidebar item text and icons. DevBrain override (shadcn uses foreground); inactive items are quiet in Figma.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Workspace tile when no colour is set.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-primary`.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Active sidebar item fill, outlined in `border-strong` as in Figma.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Active sidebar item text.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Sidebar edge.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Sidebar focus ring.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and sheets (shadcn bg-black/50).

styles.name: code
